questions.question: What happened to the kingdom after Solomon's death?
options: It was overrun by the armies of Egypt
It split into Israel (north) and Judah (south)
It stayed united under Rehoboam's rule
It expanded north into the land of Aram
questions.answer: It split into Israel (north) and Judah (south)
